title: Hormel Foods Corporation Announces Increase to Quarterly Dividend Marking 61st Consecutive Year with a Quarterly Increase
summary: Hormel Foods announced a one percent increase to its quarterly dividend on the common stock, authorized by the Board of Directors at $0.295 per share.
body_markdown:
The dividend will be paid on February 16, 2027, to stockholders of record at the close of business on January 11, 2027. This increase raises the implied annualized rate to $1.18 per share and marks the Company’s 61st consecutive year with a quarterly dividend increase.


The February 16, 2027 payment will be the 394th consecutive quarterly dividend paid by the company. Since becoming a public company in 1928, Hormel Foods Corporation has paid a regular quarterly dividend without interruption.
